name: sup-budget-off-by-one
bug: Restart window admits max+1 restarts (`>=` became `>`)

name: sup-window-edge
bug: A restart stamped exactly `window` ago still counts against the budget

name: sup-restforone-wrong-side
bug: RestForOne rebuilds the failed child and the children *before* it

name: sup-transient-restarts-on-shutdown
bug: Transient restarts on Shutdown (only Normal treated as clean)

name: sup-temporary-collateral-rebuilt
bug: A Temporary sibling stopped as collateral by OneForAll/RestForOne is rebuilt

name: sup-backoff-never-resets
bug: Backoff failure streak never resets after a stable generation

name: sup-shutdown-forward-order
bug: Supervisor stops children in declaration order instead of reverse

name: sup-budget-exhaustion-silent
bug: Exhausting the restart budget retires the child instead of failing the supervisor

name: nested-restart-mode-ignored
bug: A nested supervisor's restart mode is ignored (always Permanent)

name: link-normal-exit-kills
bug: A Normal exit kills a non-trapping linked peer

name: link-unlink-one-sided
bug: unlink removes only the caller's edge; the peer still signals it

name: link-dead-peer-normal
bug: Linking to an already-exited peer reports Normal instead of its reason

name: exit-linked-cause-dropped
bug: An actor killed through a link exits Normal, so the crash stops propagating

name: exit-shutdown-reports-normal
bug: ChildHandle::shutdown commits Normal instead of Shutdown

name: mon-down-after-demonitor
bug: The monitor waiter delivers Down even when demonitor already removed it

name: mon-dead-target-no-down
bug: Monitoring an already-dead actor returns an inert ref and no Down

name: mon-cleanup-keeps-waiters
bug: An exiting observer does not cancel its monitor waiters (they hold its handle until the target dies)

name: reg-not-removed-on-death
bug: A managed actor's registered name is never removed when its scope ends

name: mb-handle-after-stop
bug: The run loop keeps handling queued messages after stop (D4)

name: mb-send-deferred
bug: ActorRef::send enqueues from a spawned task, so a later request can overtake it (D1)

name: timer-after-cancel
bug: send_after ignores its own cancellation token (fires after cancel)

name: timer-interval-outlives-actor
bug: send_interval keeps ticking after its actor stops (only its own token stops it)

name: sys-shutdown-forward-order
bug: ActorSystem shutdown stops targets in admission order instead of reverse

name: sys-targets-unsorted
bug: System shutdown stops all standalone actors before all trees, ignoring admission order
